claims.statement: URE publishes separate materials for planned projects, completion notices, and efficiency audits; the current statute provides for certificates based on planned annual final-energy savings.

contrary_evidence: Eligibility can be lost through timing, public-aid interactions, or weak savings; established audit firms already offer application support.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: an eligibility-and-outcome dataset by technology, document defect, and URE decision sharpens screening and prices cases
fingerprint.customer: Polish factories, warehouses, commercial-property owners, and retrofit installers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: retrofit installers and equipment vendors use the service to improve project economics without building regulatory teams
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: project screening, audit coordination, application evidence, completion notice, and certificate-sale administration
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the asset owner pays a deposit at audit start and a success fee only when the certificate right is issued and monetized
fingerprint.problem_trigger: an efficiency investment is budgeted but has not yet crossed the point that would make certificate eligibility impossible

founder_fit: Strong quantitative energy fit and family installer route; regulated audit work remains with qualified partners, keeping the founder in data screening and operations.
risks: Long regulator cycles create working-capital strain.
The founder must not personally represent unlicensed audit expertise.

structure.control_point: the pre-project audit and complete URE application that can originate a tradable efficiency certificate
structure.critical_dependency: qualified energy-audit partners, customer authorization, eligibility before project execution, and URE issuance

thesis: Find eligible energy-efficiency projects before execution, coordinate the required audit and URE application through qualified partners, then monetize the issued property right for the project owner. A success-linked fee aligns payment with certificate issuance rather than selling generic energy advice. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
